newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Zedillo sends petrochem bill to congress.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Zedillo sends petrochem bill to congress.

text.p: Mexican President Ernesto Zedillo sent a bill on Thursday to the Congress to reform Article 27 of the constitution, which governs state ownership of oil and the oil industry, the Energy Ministry said in a news release.
The bill aims to clear the way for the government's plan to offer a minority stake of its petrochemical businesses on the Mexican stock exchange.
The government took up the equity scheme after backing off from a plan to totally sell off the petrochemical businesses.
The bill also seeks to more precisely define what constitutes "basic" petrochemicals, those over which the state would retain exclusive rights.
The Energy Ministry also said "actions have begun to set up subsidiaries of Pemex Petrochemicals as companies with a state majority holding."
